# Third-party assets

| File | Project | License |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor/material-color-utilities.js` | [@material/material-color-utilities](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities) 0.4.0 (single-file ESM build from jsDelivr) | Apache-2.0 — `LICENSE-material-color-utilities.txt` |
| `fonts/roboto-flex-*.woff2` | [Roboto Flex](https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-flex) (latin + latin-ext subsets from Google Fonts) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/material-symbols-rounded.woff2` | [Material Symbols Rounded](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons) (subset of the icons YTDL-UI uses) | Apache-2.0 |

All are served from this server — visitors' browsers never contact Google for fonts or colors.
To add icons, regenerate the Material Symbols subset with the extra names in `icon_names`.
